instruction: I have difficulty holding several keys at once. Turn on Windows Sticky Keys and leave it enabled for me. In the UCLA Economics Undergraduate Handbook PDF already open in Chrome, find the minimum pre-major GPA requirement for the UCLA Economics major. Save the minimum pre-major GPA in a text file named `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Enable Sticky Keys and keep it enabled.
Return to the UCLA Economics Undergraduate Handbook PDF already open in Chrome.
Find the UCLA Economics major requirements.
Find the minimum pre-major GPA requirement.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$path='HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys'; try { $flags=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name Flags -ErrorAction Stop).Flags; $value=[int]$flags; if (($value -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' } } catch { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_STATE_UNAVAILABLE' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\answer.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Output 'FILE_MISSING'; exit }; $c=Get-Content $file -Raw; if ($c -match '(?i)(?<![0-9])2\.5(?![0-9])') { Write-Output 'CORRECT_GPA_FOUND' } else { Write-Output 'INCORRECT_GPA' }"
